patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Forces Call Filter isSubscribed SharedPreferences reads to true (no Application.onCreate rewrite — avoids VerifyError).

patches.name: Unlock Lightroom Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Adobe Lightroom Premium by forcing the subscription check to return true.

patches.name: Unlock Photoshop Premium
patches.description: Forces local Adobe Photoshop entitlement checks to paid/ENTITLED. Cloud-only features may still require a server-side Adobe subscription.

patches.name: Unlock Premiere Premium
patches.description: Forces local Adobe Premiere entitlement checks (CC services / isPremium gates). Core editing is already free; cloud AI credits remain server-side.

patches.name: Unlock Pro Features
patches.description: Forces 'proActivated' and 'subscriptionActivated' to true, unlocking Pro features in Music Pitcher Radio.

patches.name: Unlock Premium (Experimental)
patches.description: Unlocks Remini premium by forcing 'isFreeUser' to true. WARNING: May cause crashes or unexpected behavior.

patches.name: Fix video engine on re-sign
patches.description: Stops libisvideoengine.so from terminating the process after the APK is re-signed. Supports arm64-v8a / armeabi-v7a; patterns cover 2.214.x and newer builds that still issue kill(pid, 9).

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Enables InShot Pro entitlements offline: export without watermark, no interstitial ads, and access to paid effects, transitions, stickers and HD. Built-in AI features that validate the store signature in native code may still refuse a re-signed package.

patches.name: Unlock Premium Features
patches.description: Unlocks permanent VIP in the accounting app.

patches.name: Unlock Pro Features
patches.description: Unlocks Days Matter Pro by forcing the pro flag to true.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Forces Adapty access levels and subscriptions to active/lifetime so My Drama treats the account as premium.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Forces local VIP / VIP Pro checks for DramaWave playback and benefits.

patches.name: Enable premium license
patches.description: Best-effort unlock of ESET premium UI / client-side license flags. Native libems + server checks may still limit some features.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Reduces Adjust / analytics style callbacks where possible. Flutter Sentry/Amplitude may still run partially.

patches.name: Unlock Plus
patches.description: Forces RevenueCat Plus entitlement checks so Finch treats the account as Finch Plus (cosmetics, full activity libraries, shop perks).

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Forces local VIP checks so locked episodes and VIP benefits open (client-side; some titles may still need a server unlock).

patches.name: Unlock SVIP Features
patches.description: Unlocks Huanxiu SVIP by forcing getSvipStatus to return 3 (SVIP).

patches.name: Unlock Pro Features
patches.description: Forces the 'is_pro_user' check to always return true, unlocking Pro features in Device Info.

patches.name: Disable signature verification
patches.description: Allows re-signed MiXplorer builds by adding the installed signing cert fingerprint to the internal allow-list.

patches.name: Hide browser Download component
patches.description: Removes DownloadActivity intent-filters so MiXplorer is not offered in browser/Firefox download choosers.

patches.name: Limit Copy to share menu
patches.description: Removes CopyActivity VIEW filters (open-with) while keeping SEND filters so Copy remains in the system share menu.

patches.name: Remove HTTP/HTTPS intent filters
patches.description: Strips http/https schemes from VIEW/BROWSABLE intent-filters so MiXplorer is not offered for web links.

patches.name: Unlock MX Player Pro
patches.description: Unlocks MX Player Pro by disabling ads and forcing pro status.

patches.name: Unlock Premium Features
patches.description: Forces local VIP membership (status, type, expire far in the future) and unlocks ad/paywall episode flags. Does not forge server purchases.

patches.name: Unlock Premium

patches.description: Optional: tries to bypass lesson energy limits. Off by default (aggressive matching previously caused startup crashes).

patches.name: Bypass Login Requirements

patches.description: Unlocks SofaScore premium and disables ads.

patches.description: Unlocks TrebEdit premium by forcing the premium check to return true.

patches.name: Remove Internet permission (Nova)
patches.description: Removes INTERNET permission from Nova Launcher and disables network-only entry points so Nova does not crash.

patches.name: Unlock Prime
patches.description: Unlocks Nova Launcher Prime by bypassing the static (isPrime) gate. WARNING: May cause crashes.

patches.name: Unlock Premium Features
patches.description: Unlocks Arc Player premium by forcing isPremiumUser to return true.

patches.name: Unlock VIP Features
patches.description: Unlocks VIP features in Wearfit Pro by forcing getIsVip() to return 1.

patches.name: App icon
patches.description: Choose a classic / premium launcher icon, or pick a PNG from your phone.

options.description: Preset icon, or Custom file to use the PNG option below.

Pick a square PNG from your phone (transparent background recommended). Used when Style is Custom file, or whenever a path is set. Ideal size ~432×432 px (xxxhdpi); the same file is copied to all densities.

patches.name: Keep deleted messages
patches.description: Show messages that were deleted for everyone. May need a fingerprint update after WhatsApp upgrades.

options.description: Mark deleted messages so they are easier to spot.

patches.name: Mods settings entry
patches.description: Reserves a MightyMich row in Settings. Full dialog wiring needs the settings-list fingerprint for this WhatsApp build.

patches.name: Mods settings resources
patches.description: Adds English strings for the MightyMich section in WhatsApp Settings.

patches.name: Read receipts
patches.description: If enabled, you won't send read receipts (blue ticks).

options.description: Always disable read receipts, ignoring the in-app toggle.

patches.name: Remove Meta AI
patches.description: Hides Meta AI on the chats home screen (FAB / pill), related hub entry points, and common feature gates. Does not delete existing Meta AI chats.

options.description: Also force extra ()Z methods in Meta-AI-anchored classes. May hide unrelated AI experiments; leave off unless the FAB still shows.

patches.name: Typing indicator
patches.description: If enabled, others won't see when you are typing.

patches.name: Usage data
patches.description: Limit diagnostic and analytics data WhatsApp sends.

patches.name: View once media
patches.description: Allow reopening and saving view once photos and videos.

patches.name: Force region
patches.description: Forces TikTok store_region-related getters to a chosen ISO country code.

options.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code to spoof (e.g. US, GB, JP, KR, PL).

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Disables common TikTok ad load/show methods (best-effort).

patches.name: Unlimited coins
patches.description: Forces Pou's coin balance getter to a very large value so shop and unlock checks always pass (local save).

patches.name: Unlock everything
patches.description: Sets shop item prices to zero and relaxes lock UI gates so items can be obtained freely (works best with Unlimited coins).

patches.description: Unlocks MagoVideo premium / VIP (no watermark, pro features).
